subject.title: /new and /reset should support @agent targeting in multi-agent channels

question: What should the supported destructive-command targeting contract be for `/new` and `/reset` in shared multi-agent channels?
rationale: The fix changes user-visible command syntax and the safety boundary for destructive session resets across channels, so automation should not choose target parsing or no-target behavior alone.

options.title: Require explicit target when ambiguous
options.body: Support an explicit agent target in native/text command handling and reject or prompt for `/new` and `/reset` when a shared channel has multiple possible agents.

options.title: Prompt chooser on omission
options.body: Support explicit targets but open an in-channel or native chooser when no target is provided in an ambiguous multi-agent channel.

options.title: Keep route-derived behavior
options.body: Preserve current route-derived reset behavior and document channel isolation or per-agent command naming as the supported deployment pattern.

recommendation.title: Require explicit target when ambiguous
recommendation.body: Support an explicit agent target in native/text command handling and reject or prompt for `/new` and `/reset` when a shared channel has multiple possible agents.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently owned the shared native-command target resolver and cross-channel call-site refactor that this contract would change.
